description: Rust-native Minecraft world storage: content-addressed section dedup + zstd container. v0.9.54 THE PROVEN ASSERT: every pristine assert is seed-verified per CI run (262144/262144 canon-compared against the seed regeneration, legends checked through the container, divergent chunks caught and stored honestly - nothing silently reverted). v0.9.55 THE WORST CASE: the -90% claim no longer rests on untouched chunks - the worst_case_probe stores ALL 262144 chunks through the normal pipeline, phase A with every pristine flag OFF (pure codec: section dedup + zstd, zero contracts exist) and phase B as the pristine lifecycle fully colonized (every contract superseded by a live edit, 0 pristine remain); both containers measured after the production maintenance pass, every stored chunk verified semantically against the edited content (jj verify pattern, bad=0 pinned), export accounts 262144 stored + 0 pristine_skipped + 0 lost; measured on 100% player-modified content: ~235-240 B/chunk pure codec (x0.058 of Anvil) and 296-301 B/chunk fully colonized (x0.073) vs 4104 B/chunk vanilla - the -92%..-94% is the codec's own arithmetic; the huge-world -99% (region-assert tier, 34 KiB at 262k) is a VERIFIED CONTENT DELTA layered on top, not an elision.
